name: Ayesha Rahman
bio: Met in first year of university. We used to study together every night before exams. She moved to Dhaka after graduation but we still try to keep in touch.

name: Tanvir Hossain
bio: My senior colleague who helped me land my first job. We grab coffee every couple of weeks and talk about tech and life goals.

name: Priya Chakraborty
bio: We grew up in the same neighborhood and went to the same school from class 1 to 10. Best memories of my childhood are with her.

name: Rakibul Islam
bio: We were roommates for 3 years in university. He knows all my embarrassing stories. Currently working as a software engineer in Chittagong.

name: Nadia Sultana
bio: We work in the same team. She is extremely talented and always brings a positive vibe to every meeting. We often have lunch together.

name: Sabbir Ahmed
bio: Our families have been friends for over 20 years. He is like a brother to me. We play football together on weekends when schedules allow.

name: Mithila Chowdhury
bio: We worked on our final year project together and became really close. She is now doing a Masters in Canada. Time zones make it hard to connect.

name: Farhan Kabir
bio: We met at the gym two years ago and instantly clicked over our shared love for fitness and cooking. We exchange healthy recipes and workout plans regularly.
